Fonts bundled with blasta (self-hosted; nothing is loaded from a third party):

  DM Sans        (c) The DM Sans Project Authors            SIL Open Font License 1.1
  JetBrains Mono (c) JetBrains s.r.o.                       SIL Open Font License 1.1

Variable-font builds (latin subset) from the Fontsource packages on npm
(@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk, @fontsource-variable/dm-sans). The SIL OFL
permits bundling, embedding and redistribution with software: https://openfontlicense.org
